brief.en: Heavy-duty wall that blocks low flying zombies
brief.zh: 血量更高的坚果墙，可以抵挡飞来的僵尸

description.en: Tall-nuts are heavy-duty wall plants that block low flying zombies.
description.zh: 高坚果是血量更厚的坚果墙，可以抵挡低空飞行的僵尸。

chat.en: Tall-nut is opening a chain of stores for Tall and Taller gentlemen. "I'll shell out the savings to you!"
chat.zh: 高坚果打算为高个子的绅士们开张连锁店，“我会把我的存货特价卖给大家！”
